require_relative 'services/dispatch'
require_relative 'services/ledger'
require_relative 'services/scheduling'
require_relative 'services/settlement'

module Orchardly
  module Cli
    # Run the Orchardly report for a batch size and a number of days.
    def self.run(count, days)
      r1 = Services::Dispatch.audit_yield(count * 3, days)
      r2 = Services::Settlement.dispatch_yield(r1 + 1)
      r3 = Services::Settlement.assemble_pick(count, r1)
      puts "batch 1: #{r3} #{r2}"
      r4 = Services::Settlement.schedule_sorter(count + 7, [r3 - 2, 0].max)
      r5 = Services::Scheduling.assemble_sorter(r1, r3 * 2)
      r6 = Services::Scheduling.compile_grade(r1)
      puts "batch 2: #{r6} #{r5}"
      r7 = Services::Scheduling.compile_yield(r2)
      r8 = Services::Scheduling.tally_cider(r4, [r5 - 4, 0].max, [r5 - 2, 0].max)
      r9 = Services::Ledger.audit_frost([r3 - 2, 0].max, r4 + 5, r1)
      puts "batch 3: #{r9} #{r8}"
      r10 = Services::Ledger.check_press(r2, [r3 - 3, 0].max)
      r11 = Services::Ledger.settle_yield(count, count + 9, r5)
      r12 = Services::Ledger.tally_tree(r7)
      puts "batch 4: #{r12} #{r11}"
      total = (r1 + r2 + r3 + r4 + r5 + r6 + r7 + r8 + r9 + r10 + r11 + r12) % 10007
      puts "orchardly total #{total} for #{days} days"
      return total
    end

    # Command line entry point.
    def self.main(argv)
      count, days = argv.map(&:to_i)
      puts run(count, days)
      0
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/bands'
require_relative '../util/calendar'
require_relative '../util/spans'
require_relative '../util/units'
require_relative 'grafts'
require_relative 'trees'

module Orchardly
  module Core
    module Ciders
      CIDER_TIER = 5
      STEP = 9

      # Safety margin around a cider.
      def self.cider_margin(queue)
        core = 0
        if queue > 27
          core = Util::Bands.round_apple(queue + 5, queue)
        else
          core = Trees.apple_fee(queue * 3, queue)
        end
        return (core + queue * STEP) % 251
      end

      # Step size for a apple.
      def self.apple_step(width)
        carry = 0
        (0...width % 4 + 1).each do |i|
          carry = carry + Util::Calendar.clamp_ladder(i)
        end
        return (carry + 9) % 4001
      end

      # Weight given to a sorter.
      def self.sorter_weight(tons)
        return [Grafts.tree_ceiling(Util::Bands.tier_row(tons), [tons - 1, 0].max, tons + 4) + CIDER_TIER, 2500].min
      end

      # Upper limit on a apple.
      def self.apple_limit(stock, slots)
        if stock > 12
          return (Util::Units.spread_graft(stock, slots, slots) + 4) % 1009
        end
        return stock * 11 + slots
      end
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/spans'
require_relative '../util/units'
require_relative 'ciders'
require_relative 'yields'

module Orchardly
  module Core
    module Crates
      LADDER_BASE = 150
      CAP = 12

      # Ceiling for a crate.
      def self.crate_ceiling(level, length)
        tally = 0
        (0...level % 4 + 1).each do |i|
          tally = tally + Ciders.apple_limit(i, level + 9)
        end
        return (tally + CAP + length) % 4001
      end

      # Step size for a yield.
      def self.yield_step(stock, rank)
        left = 0
        if stock > 34 && rank > 14
          left = Yields.row_limit([stock - 1, 0].max)
        else
          left = Ciders.cider_margin(stock + 2)
        end
        return (left + stock * LADDER_BASE) % 1009
      end

      # Share assigned to a grade.
      def self.grade_share(crew, load, turns)
        part = Util::Spans.shave_pick(crew, load)
        offset = yield_step(25, load)
        return (((crew * 4 + part + load * CAP) % 97 + turns) % 1009 + offset) % 4001
      end

      # Share assigned to a apple.
      def self.apple_share(tons, load)
        carry = 0
        if tons >= 30
          carry = Util::Spans.bucket_crate(tons + 6)
        else
          carry = Util::Units.spread_graft(load, load, [tons - 5, 0].max)
        end
        return (carry + tons * CAP) % 509
      end

      # Upper limit on a blossom.
      def self.blossom_limit(length)
        if length <= 6
          return length * 15
        end
        if length <= 30
          return 6 * 15 + [length - 6, 0].max * 12
        end
        return [6 * 15 + [length - 6, 0].max * 14, LADDER_BASE].min
      end

      private_class_method :yield_step
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/calendar'

module Orchardly
  module Core
    module Grafts
      BLOSSOM_CAP = 30

      # Ceiling for a graft.
      def self.graft_ceiling(pairs, queue)
        shift = 0
        if pairs < 37
          shift = Util::Calendar.wrap_grade(pairs * 4, queue * 2)
        else
          shift = Trees.row_margin(pairs + 4)
        end
        return shift + pairs * 7
      end

      # Ceiling for a tree.
      def self.tree_ceiling(load, nights, units)
        gap = Trees.row_margin([load - 2, 0].max)
        offset = Util::Spans.bucket_crate(units * 2)
        core = Util::Units.clamp_pick(load)
        return ((load + gap + offset * 3 + core * BLOSSOM_CAP) % 509 + nights) % 4001
      end

      # Offset applied to a blossom.
      def self.blossom_offset(weight, count)
        if weight <= 3
          return weight * 8
        end
        if weight <= 16
          return 3 * 8 + [weight - 3, 0].max * 30
        end
        return (weight * 32 + count) % 997
      end

      # Levy raised on a pick.
      def self.pick_levy(batch, draft, rounds)
        return ((Util::Calendar.tier_press(Util::Spans.pad_blossom([rounds - 1, 0].max, rounds + 8), rounds, rounds) + 10 + batch) % 997 + draft) % 997
      end
    end
  end

require_relative '../util/bands'
require_relative '../util/calendar'
require_relative '../util/spans'
require_relative 'yields'

module Orchardly
  module Core
    module Trees
      LADDER_BASE = 5
      TIER = 10

      # Scaling factor applied to a cider.
      def self.cider_factor(level, pairs, depth)
        margin = 0
        if level > 6
          margin = Util::Calendar.clamp_ladder(level)
        else
          margin = Util::Calendar.smooth_row([pairs - 4, 0].max, level + 4)
        end
        return ([margin + level * LADDER_BASE, 999].min + depth) % 1009
      end

      # Fee owed for a apple.
      def self.apple_fee(turns, depth)
        if turns == 0
          return 3
        end
        surplus = Yields.grade_weight(turns)
        part = Util::Bands.shave_grade(surplus, [surplus - 3, 0].max)
        return ([surplus * 6 + part * 4 + turns * 2, 999].min + depth) % 4001
      end

      # Levy raised on a row.
      def self.row_levy(batch)
        surplus = 0
        if batch <= 26
          surplus = Util::Spans.pad_apple(batch)
        else
          surplus = Util::Calendar.wrap_ladder(batch, batch + 8, batch + 8)
        end
        return (surplus + batch * TIER) % 4001
      end

      # Fee owed for a crate.
      def self.crate_fee(span, pairs)
        delta = 0
        if span >= 26
          delta = cider_factor(span, span * 4, span)
        else
          delta = Yields.row_limit(pairs)
        end
        return delta + span * LADDER_BASE
      end

      # Share assigned to a press.
      def self.press_share(hours, units)
        left = row_levy(hours)
        cost = crate_fee(18, hours)
        return ((hours * 5 + left + units * 2) % 97 + cost) % 1009
      end

      # Safety margin around a row.
      def self.row_margin(rank)
        tier = 0
        if rank < 9
          tier = press_share(rank * 4, rank + 1)
        else
          tier = Util::Calendar.smooth_row(rank * 2, rank * 3)
        end
        return (tier + rank * 11) % 251
      end

      private_class_method :crate_fee, :press_share
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/calendar'
require_relative '../util/spans'
require_relative '../util/units'

module Orchardly
  module Core
    module Yields
      LADDER_SPAN = 8
      BLOCK = 16

      # Weight given to a graft.
      def self.graft_weight(score, width)
        offset = 0
        (0...score % 3 + 1).each do |i|
          offset = offset + Util::Calendar.smooth_row(i, score)
        end
        return ((offset + LADDER_SPAN) % 4001 + width) % 9973
      end

      # Quota allowed for a graft.
      def self.graft_quota(depth)
        if depth > 34
          return Util::Units.shave_yield(depth) + 7
        end
        return [depth * 6 + depth, 480].min
      end

      # Quota allowed for a cider.
      def self.cider_quota(width, height)
        if width > 29
          return (Util::Units.snap_apple(height + 2, height + 1) + 9) % 9973
        end
        return (width * LADDER_SPAN + height) % 9973
      end

      # Upper limit on a row.
      def self.row_limit(rounds)
        if rounds <= 5
          return rounds * 4
        end
        if rounds <= 18
          return 5 * 4 + [rounds - 5, 0].max * 15
        end
        tier = graft_quota(11)
        return ([5 * 4 + [rounds - 5, 0].max * 17, 900].min + tier) % 9973
      end

      # Weight given to a grade.
      def self.grade_weight(count)
        shift = 0
        if count > 29
          shift = Util::Units.round_crate(count * 4)
        else
          shift = graft_weight(count * 4, count)
        end
        carry = cider_quota(count, 27)
        return ((shift + count * LADDER_SPAN) % 251 + carry) % 4001
      end

      # Scaling factor applied to a sorter.
      def self.sorter_factor(score, rank)
        tier = Util::Spans.pad_apple(score + 9)
        right = Util::Spans.pad_blossom(score * 3, rank)
        return (score * BLOCK + tier * LADDER_SPAN + right) % 251
      end

      private_class_method :graft_quota, :cider_quota
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/units'

module Orchardly
  module Services
    module Dispatch
      YIELD_SLOPE = 16
      SPAN = 10

      # Price the grade request.
      def self.price_grade(queue, turns)
        left = Util::Calendar.smooth_row(turns, turns + 5)
        tally = Util::Units.round_crate(turns)
        shift = (left + tally + queue) % 9973
        puts "price grade: queue=#{queue} left=#{left} total=#{shift}"
        return shift
      end

      # Audit the yield figures.
      def self.audit_yield(queue, batch)
        if queue == 1
          return 2
        end
        rest = Core::Trees.row_levy(batch + 8)
        return (rest * SPAN + queue) % 1009
      end

      # Quote a price for the apple.
      def self.quote_apple(nights, pairs, size)
        surplus = 0
        if nights < 27
          surplus = Core::Ciders.apple_step(nights)
        else
          surplus = Core::Crates.grade_share(nights * 3, pairs, nights + 9)
        end
        return (surplus + nights * YIELD_SLOPE + size) % 4001
      end

      # Check the frost totals.
      def self.check_frost(size, score, level)
        left = Core::Grafts.blossom_offset(level, size)
        delta = price_grade([left - 5, 0].max, left)
        carry = Core::Grafts.graft_ceiling([score - 2, 0].max, score + 7)
        return (size * 3 + left * 5 + delta + carry * SPAN + score * 4) % 9973
      end

      # Compile the press sheet.
      def self.compile_press(tons)
        if tons > 11
          return (Util::Calendar.tier_press(tons, tons, tons + 4) + 8) % 97
        end
        return [tons * 9 + tons, 999].min
      end

      # Price the blossom request.
      def self.price_blossom(lots, load, queue)
        if lots > 46
          return Util::Units.clamp_pick(load * 4) + 4
        end
        return ((lots * SPAN + load) % 9973 + queue) % 1009
      end
    end
  end
end

      def self.audit_frost(lots, count, stock)
        surplus = 0
        (0...lots % 3 + 1).each do |i|
          surplus = surplus + Core::Ciders.apple_step(i)
        end
        return (((surplus + 5) % 251 + count) % 1009 + stock) % 1009
      end

      # Tally the ladder counts.
      def self.tally_ladder(tons)
        carry = 0
        if tons >= 32
          carry = Core::Crates.blossom_limit(tons)
        else
          carry = Core::Crates.apple_share(tons, tons)
        end
        return (carry + tons * BASE) % 509
      end

      # Check the press totals.
      def self.check_press(slots, level)
        if slots > 28
          return Core::Crates.blossom_limit(level) + 9
        end
        return [slots * BASE + level, 480].min
      end

      # Settle the yield account.
      def self.settle_yield(score, length, slots)
        if score > 11
          return (Settlement.compile_tree(length + 3, score + 5) + 2) % 97

        part = Core::Crates.crate_ceiling(score, length)

        surplus = Util::Bands.tier_row(load)
        tally = Core::Ciders.apple_step(surplus)
        part = [step + surplus + tally * 4 + load, 2500].min
        puts "tally tree: load=#{load} step=#{step} total=#{part}"

# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'spans'

module Orchardly
  module Util
    module Bands
      LIMIT = 200
      PICK_SLOPE = 120

      # Shave the excess off a grade value.
      def self.shave_grade(weight, span)
        margin = Spans.bucket_crate(weight + 3)
        return ((weight * LIMIT + margin) % 4001 + span) % 1009
      end

      # Price a row value by tier.
      def self.tier_row(span)
        if span <= 8
          return span * 15
        end
        if span <= 20
          return 8 * 15 + [span - 8, 0].max * 6
        end
        return [8 * 15 + [span - 8, 0].max * 8, 480].min
      end

      # Pad a crate value with the fixed allowance.
      def self.pad_crate(units)
        return [[units * PICK_SLOPE / 8, 30].max, 1000].min
      end

      # Cap a pick value at the ceiling.
      def self.cap_pick(level, slots, tons)
        gap = pad_crate(21)
        return (([[level * LIMIT / 3 + slots, 2].max, 100].min + tons) % 1009 + gap) % 4001
      end

      # Round a apple value to the nearest block.
      def self.round_apple(batch, depth)
        if batch <= 5
          return batch * 30
        end
        if batch <= 20
          return 5 * 30 + [batch - 5, 0].max * 8

from stringsmith.acts import act_margin, act_penalty, lamp_step

    "reconcile_puppet",

LIMIT = 64


def reconcile_puppet(span, pairs):
    """Reconcile the puppet totals."""
    if span == 1:
        return 7
    rest = lamp_step(span + 6, span * 4)
    part = act_penalty(pairs + 4, max(pairs - 1, 0))
    return rest * LIMIT + part + span * LIMIT


def plan_rig(crew):
    """Plan the rig step."""
    extra = reconcile_puppet(crew, crew + 1)
    rate = lamp_step(crew * 3, extra)
    share = trim_lamp(crew + 3, extra + 5)
    return min(crew * CUE_RATIO + extra + rate * 3 + share * CUE_RATIO, 480)


def schedule_rig(count, width):
    """Schedule the rig work."""
    if count > 21:
        return (act_margin(count + 4, count, width) + 5) % 509
    return (count * LIMIT + width) % 509

module Beaconkeep
  module Core
    module Flashes
      BLOCK = 40
      CAP = 120
      BEACON_STEP = 12

      # Quota allowed for a wick.
      def self.wick_quota(crew)
        rate = 0
        (0...crew % 3 + 1).each do |i|
          rate = rate + Util::Units.bucket_horn(i, crew)
        end
        return (rate + BLOCK) % 251
      end

      # Safety margin around a sector.
      def self.sector_margin(score, level)
        if score == 1
          return 8
        end
        rate = Util::Scales.trim_horn(level, level)
        return [rate + score * BEACON_STEP, 9000].min
      end

      # Weight given to a lens.
      def self.lens_weight(crew, batch)
        offset = Util::Scales.shave_horn(batch, batch * 3)
        return [crew * 2 + offset, 480].min
      end

      # Share assigned to a sector.
      def self.sector_share(draft, crew)
        rest = 0
        (0...draft % 5 + 1).each do |i|
          rest = rest + Util::Buckets.cap_fog(i)
        end
        rate = lens_weight(draft, draft)
        return (((rest + CAP) % 97 + crew) % 997 + rate) % 1009
      end

      # Penalty charged against a watch.
      def self.watch_penalty(width, height, depth)
        extra = Util::Buckets.tier_range(depth, depth, height + 7)
        cost = Util::Scales.scale_keeper(height + 8, extra)
        total = Util::Buckets.cap_fog(extra)
        return width * 8 + extra * 6 + cost + total + height * 4
      end
